Hi Leena — nice to e-meet you. Quick note on what helps speed the security intake: 

Minimum items we typically need prior to a joint session (we can accept redacted versions):
- High-level network diagram showing where inference requests originate and where logs are stored.
- Data classification / PII table for sample payloads (columns: field, type, retention).
- Desired retention period for logs & audit trails.
- Any required region restrictions (e.g., data must stay in US-only).

We can also share our SOC2 summary and a short technical note on how KV caching and prefix caching avoid persistent full-request storage. If you can send the items above by EOD Mon (Sep 27), we can tailor the demo to your constraints and have answers ready. 

If helpful, I can run a 20-min security pre-brief on Mon Sep 27 at 11:00 PT to walk through the checklist and answer questions — say yes/no and I will add the invite.
